props.body:
Riverside Minor Hockey has run community hockey on the city's west side since 1978. We field teams from U7 through U18 and keep registration open to every family in the catchment.

  • Nine divisions across four arenas
  • Certified coaches at every level
  • Financial assistance for families who need it

Questions? Get in touch.

props.leftBody:
Our mission

Keep hockey affordable and welcoming, so that cost is never the reason a kid stops playing.

Every kid who wants to play, plays.
props.rightBody:
Our volunteers

Riverside is run by parents. Around 140 volunteers cover coaching, timekeeping, tournaments and the equipment bank each season.

  1. Coach or assistant coach
  2. Team manager
  3. Tournament crew

items.title: How do I register?
items.body: Registration runs online. Create an account, pick your division, and pay in full or in three instalments.

items.title: What equipment does my child need?
items.body:
Full protective gear and a CSA-approved helmet. Our equipment bank lends gear at no cost.

  • Helmet with cage
  • Shoulder and elbow pads
  • Skates and stick

items.title: Is financial assistance available?
items.body: Yes. We never turn a family away for cost — email the registrar and the conversation stays confidential.

diagnostics.message: Volunteer application form found but intake forms are never imported. Rebuild by hand; it collected: full name, email, phone, preferred role, police check on file (yes/no), availability (checkbox list), notes.
Source logo was SVG, which is not an accepted asset type. Rasterized to PNG at 1024px on the long edge and declared as site-logo.
Sponsor logo carousel with a per-logo hyperlink on each item — no block supports per-item links. Placed the Sponsors widget instead, which renders live sponsor records.
